seo.title: Licensing & Reprints — ITMAP
seo.description: License ITMAP vendor evaluations, market reports, and forecasts for internal use, marketing, sales enablement, or analyst-style reprint rights.

hero.subtitle: Our research and graphics are protected intellectual property. Here's what requires a licence and how to get one.

requirements.requiredDescription: The following always require a ITMAP reprint licence when used by vendors or for promotional / marketing purposes:
requiredItems: Charts, diagrams, matrices, market maps or other graphics created by ITMAP
Research content: report excerpts, key takeaways, ratings, quotes, summaries or narrative text
Data points or findings unique to ITMAP (even if paraphrased) when used to endorse products or services
Thumbnails or screengrabs of our graphics
Use of ITMAP logos, product marks or badges
requirements.notRequiredTitle: What does not require a licence?
notRequiredItems: Linking to public ITMAP pages using article or report titles
Short, purely editorial citations in neutral journalistic contexts (vendors must still obtain a license)

submitRequest.title: Submit a request
submitRequest.description: Email support@itmap.ai with the asset(s) you want to use, the full context (pages, URLs, channels, languages) and intended audience reach.

scopeAndQuote.title: We scope and quote
scopeAndQuote.description: Fees depend on asset type, distribution geography, channels, duration and exclusivity. We'll respond within 2 business days.

agreementInvoice.title: Agreement & invoice
agreementInvoice.description: We issue a short reprint licence agreement. Once executed and paid, you'll receive approved files and attribution copy.

implementAttribute.title: Implement & attribute
implementAttribute.description: Publish using our supplied assets, attribution line and optional Licensed Reprint badge.

complianceReview.title: Compliance review
complianceReview.description: For high-visibility placements, we can pre-review to ensure brand and research integrity before go-live.

renewOrRetire.title: Renew or retire
renewOrRetire.description: Licences expire at the end of the agreed term. You may renew or remove the content.

contact.title: Questions about licensing?
contact.description: Our team typically responds within 2 business days.
